title: 692. Number of Longest Increasing Subsequence

examples.explanation: The best length is 4 via [1,3,4,7] and [1,3,5,7], so there are 2 such runs.
Every single element is a longest run of length 1, giving 5 runs.
Only one increasing run uses all three values.

hints: For each position store the length of the best increasing run ending there and how many such runs exist.
Extend position i from every earlier j with nums[j] < nums[i], keeping the max length and summing counts on ties.
The answer is the total count of positions whose length equals the global maximum.
